claim: LEO lowers total energy vs hopcount at relayCap=1 without interference
allowed_wording: LEO used less total energy than hopcount in the cap1 non-interference primary stratum.

claim: LEO lowers total energy vs hopcount at relayCap=2 without interference
allowed_wording: No supported energy difference was detected at cap2.

claim: LEO lowers total energy vs hopcount at relayCap=3 without interference
allowed_wording: No supported energy saving was detected at cap3.

claim: LEO reduces ping timeouts vs hopcount across non-interference relay caps
evidence: R6 primary_summary.csv; all three caps Holm-significant
allowed_wording: LEO had fewer ping timeouts than hopcount in all three non-interference relay-cap strata.

claim: LEO reduces no-route outcomes vs hopcount across non-interference relay caps
evidence: R6 primary_summary.csv; all three caps Holm-significant
allowed_wording: LEO had fewer no-route outcomes than hopcount in all three non-interference relay-cap strata.

claim: LEO uses less energy than operational LQI
allowed_wording: LEO used more total energy than operational LQI in all three non-interference relay-cap strata.

claim: LEO generally improves no-route behavior vs operational LQI
evidence: R6 primary_summary.csv; cap1 significantly worse, cap2/3 inconclusive
allowed_wording: No general no-route advantage over operational LQI is supported.

claim: Interference strata establish significant LEO energy effects
evidence: 5 cells/stratum; exact two-sided sign-flip min p=0.0625
allowed_wording: Interference results are limited-evidence sensitivity results, not confirmatory significance claims.

claim: LEO changes routes relative to hopcount and LQI
allowed_wording: Among jointly successful PINGs, LEO often selected a different routeFingerprint.

claim: LQI-literal is an independent useful baseline in the static primary domain
evidence: 105 config pairs; 2100 main and 399000 route rows exactly match hopcount
allowed_wording: The literal Eq.2-3 baseline is degenerate with hopcount in the tested static primary domain.

claim: Eq.17 bounded vs literal changes the frozen sensitivity results
evidence: 36 configs; main effects zero; 136800 route transactions identical
allowed_wording: No operational difference was observed between bounded and literal Eq.17 over the tested sensitivity domain.

claim: nRF52840 energy accounting changes routing decisions
allowed_wording: Changing energy accounting altered the absolute energy scale but not routing in the frozen sensitivity set.

claim: The mobility extension is part of source-reproduction primary inference
allowed_wording: Mobility results are exploratory extensions and are reported separately.

claim: v1.1.0 exactly replays the unpublished source simulator
allowed_wording: v1.1.0 is an independent source-constrained reconstruction, not an exact replay.

claim: LEO is universally the best routing metric
allowed_wording: No universal superiority claim is supported.
